profile_text.body:
MarketMuse is a software company that provides AI-powered content planning and optimization tools, primarily aimed at helping organizations determine what content to write and how to improve their search rankings by identifying areas where competitors are weak. The company describes itself as having used AI in its product for over ten years, and says its system fetches hundreds to thousands of pages of content for every page and topic analyzed, removes low-quality outliers, and applies a combination of proprietary and open-source algorithms to classify parts of speech and calculate relevance.

The core MarketMuse product is categorized as a writing and editing tool that covers content strategy, topic modeling, site-wide content auditing, and competitive intelligence. The company states its patented AI automatically analyzes a customer's entire content inventory, identifies high-value topic clusters, and surfaces quick wins based on existing authority. An Optimize application within the platform includes a generative AI component to assist with content creation, though the company notes it does not write content for customers directly, framing its role as helping users understand what to write and how much.

The site holds a registered product page for MarketMuse but no litigation, MCP server registrations, or SEC filings are recorded in the available data.
